headline: Two great new repairable gadgets
summary: Discover the latest highly repairable gadgets. Includes new models like the Fairphone 6 Plus. Also features the Framework 12 laptop for easy maintenance.

headline: HoverAir’s transforming modular drone has already been halted in the US
summary: The modular HoverAir Versa drone is halted in the US. FCC ban stopped US orders just three days after its Indiegogo debut. The transforming steadycam drone may be forced to abandon US shipping.

headline: TikTok will pay $400 million to settle DOJ child privacy lawsuit
summary: TikTok settles a DOJ lawsuit for $400 million. The suit alleged violations of the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). TikTok was accused of collecting child data without parental consent.

headline: Over 1 million people have clicked LinkedIn’s AI slop button
summary: LinkedIn introduced an "AI slop" reporting button. Over 1 million users have already clicked the button. The feature allows reporting AI-generated content perceived as low quality.

headline: Pokémon ETBs are Surprisingly Easy to Get Hold of Right Now on Amazon
summary: Pokémon TCG Elite Trainer Boxes (ETBs) are now readily available on Amazon. High-demand boxes, including exclusives, have been restocked. Prices are currently below secondary market rates.

headline: How Elgato Can Level Up Your WFH Setup - From Lighting, To Audio, And More
summary: Elgato products can significantly enhance your work-from-home setup. Improve productivity and comfort with specialized gear. Solutions cover lighting, audio, and other essential WFH upgrades.

headline: The Sinking City 2 Review
summary: "The Sinking City 2" is reviewed, drawing comparisons to "Resident Evil". It's praised as a commendable imitation of its horror inspirations. The game is deeply embedded in the Cthulhu mythos.

headline: 'Hoping for a Huge October Surprise, But Not Holding My Breath' — Arc Raiders Players Torn After Embark Delays Future Expeditions Until Early 2027
summary: "Arc Raiders" future Expeditions are delayed until early 2027. Embark Studios aims for major improvements based on community feedback. Players express mixed feelings about the significant delay.

headline: Seven dead after police vehicle and car crash during pursuit
summary: Seven people died in a police pursuit collision near Middlesbrough. The fatalities include two police officers. A police watchdog has launched an investigation into the crash.

headline: Canada says it will match US tariffs 'dollar for dollar' as trade talks break down
summary: Canada pledges to match new US tariffs "dollar for dollar." Trade talks between the two nations have broken down. A 50% levy on $20bn of Canadian imports is now in effect.

headline: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
summary: Rescuers are searching a Ukrainian mall after a Russian strike. The attack killed 16 and injured 130, with four still missing. President Zelensky condemned the strike as "despicable."

headline: How this 1960s ex-council house is managing to stay cool without air con
summary: A 1960s ex-council house stays cool without air conditioning. It achieves this by adhering to the Passivhaus standard. This energy-efficient building standard is gaining popularity in the UK.
